_header: DRAFT: extra clarify practice items written by Claude on Nov 18, 2026, INFORMED BY Run A (the failure class: long clear questions with personal context that the clarify step stopped, and vague questions that use a generic noun). NOT approved by the owner, NOT the evaluation set. Items are written from the design, not from any evaluation question; a test checks that no item equals or nearly equals an evaluation, calibration, tuning or held-out text. Used only by scripts/check_clarify.py --set extra to measure the clarify guard (P2) on and off.
note: X01-X12 are clear (expected search); X13-X16 are vague with a generic noun (expected clarify): the guard is expected to turn some of those into searches, and this set measures how many.

question: I'm pregnant and my gums bleed when I brush, can I still get a regular cleaning with you and what does it cost?
My teenage son chipped a front tooth playing football yesterday, do you see emergencies on the same day and who should he call?
My employer changed our insurance to Aetna this year, do you accept it and will you file the claim for me?
I have a root canal booked for next week and I'm really nervous, can I take something to calm down beforehand?
My mother uses a wheelchair, is there step-free access from the car park to your front desk?
I'd like to put my husband and me on your membership plan, how much is it per month and what does it cover?
After my extraction last week the socket still aches, is that normal or should I call you?
I have a toothache at 9 pm on a Sunday, what number do I ring and is there a fee for the emergency visit?
Can I pay for my daughter's braces in monthly instalments, and is there a deposit?
We are a family of four and want check-ups on the same morning, can you book us back to back?
I wear a night guard from my old dentist, can you adjust it here and what would you charge?
My little boy is three and terrified of the chair, from what age do you see children and how do you handle anxious ones?
Does the treatment hurt a lot?
What do I need to do before the procedure?
Is my dentist available on Saturday?
How long should I wait after the appointment before eating?
